# Försvarsfokus: Här lägger förvaltaren pengarna

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode is an interview with Joakim Agerback, who manages a defence fund. He says European and global defence spending is a long-term structural trend, but expects volatility and slower growth than in recent years. He is broadly positive: Q2 reports beat expectations, the sector is still under-owned by institutions and current price levels look like a good entry point. He sees opportunity in maritime and shipbuilders, air defence, army equipment, command-and-control, space and unmanned systems, and highlights Theon, Embraer and Rheinmetall, while calling Saab's valuation a premium that already prices in positive surprises.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 THEON — Theon | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest picks Theon as a way to play army re-equipment: night vision, communication systems and autonomy for soldiers.

#### Reasoning

The guest (a fund manager) expects Europe to need to equip larger land forces against the Russian threat and to reduce its dependence on the US (Anduril). Theon's night vision and command systems are expanding from special forces to wider use, and it is growing strongly. He advises small, spread-out position sizes because of sector volatility.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the European army re-equipment budget stalls
- if growth slows
- if a US supplier wins European programmes

> *"Grekiska Teon. Precis. Som kanske är ett sätt att spela på just armén."*

---

### 🟢 EMBR3 — Embraer | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Winning C-390 orders, growing defence unit, strong private jets, recent turnaround and little correlation with the sector.

#### Reasoning

The guest highlights Embraer's defence growth from C-390 transport aircraft orders, its strong private jet business and improved performance after a tougher period. Its low correlation with other defence stocks helps diversify the fund, and a deeper partnership with Saab (possible Gripen production in Brazil) is upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if C-390 order momentum fades
- if the private jet market weakens
- if the Saab partnership does not deepen

> *"Det ser intressant ut. Om man kan fördjupa samarbetet med Saab kan man ha en uppsida."*

---

### 🟢 RHM — Rheinmetall | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund added to European core holdings after valuations fell; guest thinks Rheinmetall's decline is too large.

#### Reasoning

The guest thinks the drop after losing the frigate order is too large given Rheinmetall's market position and order intake; it will still win its share of other orders. He sees potential in unmanned ground vehicles, driven by lessons from Ukraine. The fund has raised its European core holdings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if more big orders are lost
- if order intake weakens
- if margins fail to hold

> *"Drivet neråt i Rheinmetall skulle jag säga är väl högt sett till deras starka position i marknaden och orderingången de har."*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Premium valuation already prices in ongoing positive surprises; GlobalEye position is strong; more radar and Dynamics orders could lift the stock.

#### Reasoning

The guest notes that Saab keeps a relatively high valuation while the rest of the sector has lost its premium, so continued positive surprises are already priced in. The stock can rise further on GlobalEye follow-on orders in radar/sensors and in the higher-margin Dynamics unit. Uncertainty remains around next-generation fighter partners, the Brazil Gripen deal and a possible share issue.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake disappoints
- if Saab issues shares at a discount
- if it is sidelined in the next-generation fighter programme
- if margins weaken

> *"Jag tror att det finns inbakat i den prissättningen att man kommer få löpande positiva överraskningar som det här."*

---

### 🟠 ASB — Austal | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Low-valued shipbuilder facing strong demand for frigates and unmanned maritime systems, though delays and cost overruns are expected.

#### Reasoning

The guest sees strong maritime demand from threats to sea lanes and says shipbuilders are generally low-valued, a good opportunity. He also expects negative surprises, delays and rising costs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if frigate orders are cancelled
- if cost overruns hurt margins

> *"Alla de här stora skeppstillverkarna har en ganska låg värdering."*

---

### 🟠 042660 — Hanwha Ocean | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Low-valued shipbuilder that benefits from maritime demand.

#### Reasoning

The guest names it among low-valued shipbuilders with good opportunity, while warning of delays and cost increases.

#### Sell Triggers

- if frigate orders are cancelled
- if cost overruns hurt margins

> *"Jag tror att det finns en väldigt bra möjlighet där"*

---

### 🟠 HII — Huntington Ingalls | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Low-valued US shipbuilder that benefits from maritime demand.

#### Reasoning

The guest names it among low-valued shipbuilders with good opportunity, while warning of delays and cost increases.

#### Sell Triggers

- if navy orders are cut
- if cost overruns hurt margins

> *"Jag tror att det finns en väldigt bra möjlighet där"*

---

### 🟡 KOG — Kongsberg | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

One of the fund's largest holdings; benefits from air-defence and Patriot shortfalls.

#### Reasoning

The guest says air defence is still Europe's biggest need, stockpiles are empty and Kongsberg is part of the Patriot supply chain. Held as a core position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if air-defence procurement slows

> *"Då har man ändå till exempel Kongsberg, RTX, Ratheon, de är en del i leverera Patriot-systemet"*

---

### 🟡 RTX — RTX (Raytheon) | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

One of the fund's largest holdings; supplier of the Patriot system, which faces large shortfalls.

#### Reasoning

Supplies the Patriot system, which is in large shortfall while air defence remains the main European need. Held as a core position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Patriot demand or production falters

> *"Att vi har stora underskott där."*

---

### 🟡 012450 — Hanwha Aerospace | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fund holding described as very strong.

#### Reasoning

A holding the guest calls 'very strong'; it fits his thesis on artillery and army equipment needs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if export orders slow

> *"Hanva Aerospace är också väldigt stark."*
